name: com.itkamianets.3d-unity-shell
description: The shared structure every Temnorid game follows, taken from the Lords app: a splash while the game finds out who is playing and whether it is up to date, a landing screen, a one-time onboarding for a name and a colour, a lobby for playing with others, and in-game chrome with a top bar and a bottom bar of places. Games add their own places; the shell owns the rest.
